capabilities: Display all 365 days of a year in one scrollable or fit-to-screen view
Place single-day and multi-day notes using date properties or YYYY-MM-DD filename patterns
Create daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, yearly, and custom periodic notes from the calendar
Register recurring notes with yearly/monthly/weekly frequency or RRULE patterns
Filter and color-categorize displayed notes with property, tag, and text conditions
extras: README warns the plugin is in active development and may change significantly, states it is being developed with AI help, and documents BRAT installation with pre-release versions before 0.4.3.
problem: Obsidian has no single view showing when every dated note falls across a whole year, making it hard to see events and gaps chronologically.

relations.evidence: Compatible with the Periodic Notes Plugin – no transfer or copying needed

summary: Year-at-a-glance calendar view that places single-day and multi-day notes on their dates, extracted from frontmatter properties or filenames.
